baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'send down upon us a table from heaven' is closed by the doubled provision root in 'provide us' and 'best of providers.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Descent, prepared guest-provision, a food-bearing tray, and nourishment form a host-to-guests mechanism: the requested object is divine hospitality delivered to a dependent plural community.

activation_trace.role: Prepared provision for an arriving guest makes the descent function as hospitality sent to the community.
The food-bearing tray supplies the concrete shared meal at the center of the hospitality.
Nourishing sustenance makes the final plea define the table's intended use rather than merely its arrival.

changed_reading.before: A request for a miraculous meal to descend.
changed_reading.after: A request that the divine host deliver prepared hospitality to a dependent community.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The table is asked to 'be' an Eid for 'our first and our last.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Occurrence in time, return, counted recurrence, and the two temporal edges convert one descended meal into a repeatable memorial that binds a community across succession.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time make the table's requested function temporal, not merely material.
A condition that returns supplies the explicit recurring-festival mechanism.
Counted time and its recurrence sharpen Eid into a calendrical return rather than a single happy occasion.
Beginning and precedence establish one temporal edge of the memorial community.
Later or last members establish the other edge and require transmission beyond the first witnesses.

changed_reading.before: The meal would give the present group a day of celebration.
changed_reading.after: The meal is commissioned as a recurring memorial institution joining the community's beginning to its later members.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same requested table is called both a sign from God and provision from the best provider.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visible indication and apportioned, beneficial nourishment occupy one object. The sign proves through sustaining and sharing, so its epistemic force cannot be detached from material benefit.

activation_trace.role: Feeding, benefit, and gift make the table an enacted benefit rather than a bare spectacle.
A manifest sign supplies the table's evidentiary visibility.
An apportioned gift makes reception and distribution part of how the sign works.
Beneficial good qualifies divine provision by its positive effect, not abundance alone.

changed_reading.before: The table is food plus a separate miracle proving divine power.
changed_reading.after: Its mode of proof is nourishing benefit itself: evidence arrives as apportioned provision.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The appeal to 'our Lord' precedes the request, while the table is asked to become a lasting communal occasion.
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship as repair, gradual completion, feeding, and growth turns provision into formation. The table is requested as an instrument by which a plural 'we' is maintained and matured.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion give 'our Lord' a formative function over the receiving community.
Feeding and growth make the requested provision a means of communal development.
Feeding, benefit, and gift provide the material instrument of that formation.

changed_reading.before: The Lord is addressed as the power able to supply food.
changed_reading.after: The Lord is asked to form and maintain a community through a recurring material gift.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speaker is named as Jesus son of Mary before he invokes God as 'our Lord' and speaks for 'us.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Spoken petition, human filiation, divine invocation, and shared lordship establish a lineage-marked human mediator representing a plural community before its Lord.

activation_trace.role: An utterance brought into speech presents the verse as the mediator's public petition.
Filiation and attribution to an origin locate the speaker in human lineage.
The divine name in direct invocation fixes the addressee of the petition.
Lordship, ownership, and authority place speaker and beneficiaries together under the invoked Lord.

changed_reading.before: Jesus personally asks God for the disciples' requested object.
changed_reading.after: A lineage-marked human spokesman converts the group's desire into a public petition to their shared Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The food sequence distinguishes nourishing provision and reparative feeding from consumption that generates hostility and blocks remembrance. This revises the Eid-table into a recurring social practice whose proper output is shared benefit and recollection, not appetite alone.

activation_trace.role: Nourishing sustenance locates ordinary eating inside divine provision.
Feeding another turns food into a reparative transfer, not private consumption.
Enmity supplies the destructive social output against which the shared table is read.
Restored recollection supplies the positive attentional output of a rightly ordered recurring meal.
The focus table's feeding, benefit, and gift image anchors the social mechanism in the requested object.

structural_cues: 5:87-93 repeatedly coordinate food with lawful limits, wholesome quality, restraint, reparative feeding, remembrance, and worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beneficial food, expiatory feeding, and consumption producing enmity and distraction; I infer that a recurring table is meant to reproduce the first outputs and resist the second. It could alternatively remain only a meal governed by the same rules.

changed_reading.before: The descended table gives a community food and a celebration.
changed_reading.after: The table is a regulated communal practice that converts provision into repair and remembrance instead of rivalry and distraction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacred house, sacred month, offerings, and markers are made a support for people; the focus table likewise joins material provision to a recurring date. Eid can therefore operate as communal infrastructure that gives a people temporal and social standing.

activation_trace.role: Support, subsistence, and an upright prop supply the institutional function activated for the table-and-Eid pair.
The returning festival gives that social support a recurring temporal form.

structural_cues: 5:97 combines a house, a sacred month, sacrificial gifts, and visible markers as a single arrangement made qiyam for people.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a place-time-gift complex that supports people; I analogically assign the focus's table-time pair a similar supporting role. The alternative is that qiyam remains specific to the institutions in 5:97.

changed_reading.before: Eid names the community's joy at receiving the table.
changed_reading.after: The recurring table is a compact social institution that helps a community stand together across time.

context_deltas.mechanism: A request for disclosed material can remove uncertainty, but the packet pairs such asking with later concealment of the received truth and then attaches exceptional punishment to disbelief after this table descends. The sign is therefore a self-binding evidentiary threshold.

activation_trace.role: Request and inquiry supply the initiating act whose answered disclosure can increase responsibility.
Delivery by descent ties disclosure to material made present from above.
Covering a blessing supplies the failure mode that can follow an answered request.
The promised delivery directly completes the focus petition and closes the space for uncertainty.
Covering the received blessing after delivery defines post-sign betrayal.
Painful punishment supplies the exceptional consequence attached to that betrayal.
The focus's manifest sign anchors the accountability threshold in the requested table.

structural_cues: 5:101-102 warn that requested disclosure can end in disbelief; 5:115 answers this exact descent request with an unmatched post-reception sanction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies request, disclosure, prior disbelief, and a direct post-descent sanction; I infer the arrow 'more manifest evidence, less excusable denial.' Alternatively, the warning may concern only this community's explicit covenant.

changed_reading.before: A sign resolves doubt and supplies reassurance.
changed_reading.after: The requested sign also binds its recipients: reassurance is purchased by sharply increased accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Formal testimony, replacement witnesses, fulfilled truth, and the disciples' wish to witness turn the table into an evidence-producing public event. 'Our first and our last' can name a transmission chain that carries observed truth beyond the original eaters.

activation_trace.role: Testimony stated from knowledge supplies a disciplined public-evidence model.
Other or later witnesses supply succession when the first evidentiary holders are insufficient.
Truth realized in action makes the table the fulfillment against which the prior word is tested.
Presence with observation makes the disciples direct witnesses rather than report recipients.
The focus's first members become the initial holders of the observed event.
The focus's later members become the downstream recipients of transmitted testimony.

structural_cues: 5:106-108 stage testimony as a procedure that survives compromised witnesses; 5:113 explicitly ends the disciples' motives with becoming witnesses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a witness-replacement procedure and direct observation of fulfilled truth; I infer that the Eid carries evidence from first observers to later members. Alternatively, 'first and last' may mark beneficiaries without a testimonial office.

changed_reading.before: The table is a sign enjoyed by present and future members.
changed_reading.after: The table inaugurates a recurring witness-chain through which first observers transmit fulfilled truth to later members.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recalled gifts to Jesus repeatedly become effective only by divine permission. The focus's 'a sign from You' therefore functions as an agency boundary: this new wonder joins a prior sequence whose beneficiary or mediator is never its independent source.

activation_trace.role: Blessing and good condition frame the preceding wonders as received favor.
Repeated authorization makes divine permission the enabling condition for each wonder.
The creature's coming-to-be supplies a concrete effect whose agency is permission-conditioned.
The focus sign remains visibly attached to its stated source, 'from You.'

structural_cues: 5:110 repeats 'by My permission' across creation-like animation, healing, and bringing out the dead before the table dialogue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated permission formula for earlier wonders; I infer that 'from You' deliberately places the table under the same agency grammar. Alternatively, it may be ordinary acknowledgment of the gift's source.

changed_reading.before: The table is one more miracle associated with Jesus's prayer.
changed_reading.after: The prayer publicly marks the table as a divine act mediated by Jesus but neither generated nor owned by him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disciples frame the issue as the Lord's ability and list eating, settled hearts, verified truth, and witness as desired outputs. Jesus retains the object but rewrites the request around shared lordship, divine origin, recurring communal benefit, and provision.

activation_trace.role: Ability and capacity supply the disciples' initial problem-frame.
Calm and settledness supply the affective result the disciples seek.
The heart is the stated site where the requested evidence is meant to settle uncertainty.
A word fulfilled in action supplies the requested verification.
Presence with observation supplies the desired witness status.
Direct invocation replaces a question about capacity with address to God.
Shared lordship moves the request from 'your Lord' to the petitioner's and disciples' common dependence.
Apportioned gift recasts eating as reception from the best provider.

structural_cues: 5:112 asks about capacity and receives a warning; 5:113 itemizes the group's motives; 5:114 preserves the table but changes the grammar, addressee, scope, and closing rationale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two differently worded requests and the disciples' motives; I infer that Jesus is ethically mediating and reframing their demand. Alternatively, his prayer may simply be a fuller equivalent of their request.

changed_reading.before: Jesus relays the disciples' request for food and reassurance.
changed_reading.after: Jesus converts a capacity-test and appetite-centered demand into God-centered supplication for communal, recurring provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogation contrasts taking Jesus and Mary as deities with Jesus's declaration of worship toward God, 'my Lord and your Lord.' Against that future scene, 'Jesus son of Mary' and 'O God, our Lord' in the focus become a performative hierarchy encoded inside the wonder narrative.

activation_trace.role: Worship and the object made divine supply the disputed status from which the focus invocation separates Jesus.
Human filiation repeats the focus's lineage marker inside the interrogation.
Divine transcendence and exoneration reject the attributed elevation.
Submissive worship gives the command Jesus reports and fixes God as its sole object.
The shared Lord of Jesus and his audience repeats the hierarchy voiced in the focus prayer.
The focus's human filiation anchors the speaker below the Lord he invokes.

structural_cues: 5:116-117 revisit Jesus's identity, speech, worship, and shared lordship after recounting the table.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matching identity and lordship formulas around a later deification charge; I infer that the focus wording already guards the wonder against elevating its mediator. Alternatively, the names and vocatives may be conventional rather than anticipatory.

changed_reading.before: The speaker's name and the divine vocative identify participants in the prayer.
changed_reading.after: Those formulas make the table prayer itself testify that its human mediator and recipients stand together under one Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing outcome joins truth that benefits with gardens whose provision flows and endures. This opens a second horizon for the focus's first-last, recurring feast: a finite meal can rehearse the final conversion of true witness into unending provision.

activation_trace.role: Benefit opposed to harm makes truthful witness productive at the final outcome.
Continuing provision and gift give the final garden an ongoing sustenance mechanism.
Stable persistence beyond quick decay contrasts final provision with the table's finite meal.
Long duration and permanence extend the provision horizon beyond recurring historical time.
The focus's recurring feast supplies a finite temporal rehearsal for that enduring horizon.

structural_cues: 5:119 moves from truthful witness to beneficial final outcome, flowing provision, and permanence immediately before the closing declaration of divine dominion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring provision in the focus and enduring provision at the close; I infer a rehearsal-to-fulfillment relation. The live alternative is that 'first and last' refers only to historical generations.

changed_reading.before: The Eid preserves a past gift for successive generations.
changed_reading.after: The recurring meal also acts as a finite foretaste of the final, non-decaying provision attached to truthful witness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the motion and swaying branch behind the table noun, not its ordinary tray branch alone. It remains anchored in the focus table and recurring Eid and is sharpened by the immediately preceding settled hearts. Render it only as a branch-triggered material metaphor, not as a claim that the noun lexically means social stabilization.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The table word carries both a tray branch and a motion-disturbance branch, while the table is asked to become a recurring communal occasion.

activation_trace.role: Motion, disturbance, and leaning supply the unstable material state to be transformed.
The food-bearing tray gives that unstable image a concrete shared center.
A returning communal condition makes stabilization repeatable rather than momentary.
Calm and settledness name the immediate desired effect that the table-center answers.

changed_reading.before: A table arrives to satisfy hunger and commemorate the event.
changed_reading.after: The recurring table becomes a shared center that converts swaying desire and uncertainty into settled communal orientation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the table through the rain-as-provision branch rather than treating descent as transport of a finished object only. It remains anchored in 'send down,' 'from heaven,' the table's feeding branch, and 'provide us.' Render it as a material analogy that intensifies dependence, not as a denial of an extraordinary descent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly links descent from heaven, a feeding gift, and the doubled provision root.

activation_trace.role: Delivery by descent supplies the vertical transfer from source to recipients.
The sky and whatever rises overhead supply the elevated material source-domain.
Rain descending as provision connects heavenly descent to the production of sustenance.
Feeding, benefit, and gift make the table the concentrated edible endpoint of that descent.

changed_reading.before: A finished meal is transported downward as a miracle.
changed_reading.after: The table concentrates the ordinary heaven-to-sustenance dependency into one visible, edible sign.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant W-S-M mapping for the focus's S-M-W occurrence. It remains valid as an activation because the same focus construction explicitly calls the descended object a visible sign from God. Downstream prose should label it a split-root resonance, never an etymological equation of sky and mark.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The table comes 'from the sky' and is immediately purposed as 'a sign from You.'

activation_trace.role: A visible mark by which something is recognized makes provenance itself perceptible.
The manifest sign gives the marked-provenance resonance an explicit focus anchor.
Descent and arrival make the recognized origin a feature of the event's movement.

changed_reading.before: The table's heavenly origin and its status as a sign are two adjacent facts.
changed_reading.after: Its descent is imagined as bearing a recognizable mark of provenance: origin is part of what the sign displays.

strongest_changes: The table becomes a regulated communal practice that turns provision into repair and remembrance rather than rivalry.
The answered request becomes a self-binding threshold: manifest reassurance sharply increases accountability.
The table becomes an observed event carried through a first-to-last witness chain.
Jesus reframes a capacity-test and appetite-centered demand as supplication to a shared Lord and provider.
The prayer's lineage and lordship formulas guard the wonder against elevating its human mediator.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made one table operate simultaneously as hospitality, recurring institution, beneficial evidence, risky disclosure, transmitted witness, and an agency boundary. The unusual split-root activations also exposed material images of stabilization, rain-fed provision, and marked provenance without requiring them to displace the stronger models.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 'our first and our last' primarily denotes generations, temporal endpoints, or first and later witnesses.
Whether Eid specifies a repeated calendar observance or a singular event with recurring memory.
How far the legal witness and communal-support mechanisms should be carried beyond contextual analogy.
Whether the non-dominant W-S-M activation is useful enough for downstream prose or should remain trace-only.
